questions.question: Work out 864 divided by 24 by taking away chunks.
questions.expected_answer: 30 times 24 is 720, and 864 minus 720 is 144. 6 times 24 is 144, and 144 minus 144 is 0. The chunks are 30 and 6, so the answer is 36.

questions.question: Check that 576 divided by 32 equals 18 by multiplying.
questions.expected_answer: 18 times 32 is 10 times 32 plus 8 times 32, which is 320 plus 256, which is 576. So 576 divided by 32 is 18.

questions.question: Work out 500 divided by 32 and explain the remainder.
questions.expected_answer: 15 times 32 is 480 and 16 times 32 is 512, which is too big. 500 minus 480 is 20, so the answer is 15 remainder 20. The remainder, 20, is smaller than 32, so no more groups of 32 fit.
